As the [[Eighth Brother]] uses his TIE/ad v1 during the events of "[[Twilight of the Apprentice]]," which ''Timelines'' dates to [[3 BBY]], it must have been manufactured between those two [[Standard year|years]]. |destroyed= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Inquisitorius]] |navy= |fleet= |owners=*[[Eighth Brother]] *[[Maul]] |captains= |registry= |aliases= }} {{Listen3|EighthBrotherTIE-TwilightOfTheApprenticePart2.flac|the howl of the TIE fighter's engines}} The '''Eighth Brother's TIE fighter''' was a [[TIE/ad v1]] [[starfighter]] used by the [[Eighth Brother]], a [[Jedi hunter]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Inquisitorius]]. It was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] sometime between [[4 BBY]] and [[3 BBY]]. The [[TIE series|TIE]] was equipped with [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]] and an armament of two [[L-s9.1 laser cannon]]s and a [[projectile launcher]]. With a [[P-s5.2 twin ion engine]], the TIE fighter could reach speeds up to 1,600 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]], or 994 [[Mile per hour|miles per hour]], in [[atmosphere]] with a maximum acceleration of 4,150 G. In 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the Eighth [[Brother (Inquisitorius)|Brother]] piloted the starfighter to the [[planet]] [[Malachor]] in his search for the former [[Sith]] [[Maul]], a task assigned to him by the Inquisitorius leader, [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. There, his TIE/ad v1 was tracked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] [[Ezra Bridger]], [[C1-10P]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], and [[Ahsoka Tano]] during their [[Mission to Malachor|search]] for knowledge to defeat the [[Inquisitor]]s. The Eighth Brother confronted the rebels but attempted to flee to his starfighter, arriving too late as the [[astromech droid]] C1-10P found his [[starship]] and turned it against him. The Inquisitor later [[Death|perished]] on Malachor, leaving his starfighter to be claimed by Maul. ==Description== {{Listen3|EighthBrotherTIELasers-TwilightOfTheApprenticePart1.flac|the TIE fighter's laser cannons}} The Eighth Brother's TIE fighter{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2016/03/31/star-wars-rebels-dave-filoni-on-ahsokas-fate-mauls-return-and-much-more|text=Star Wars Rebels: Dave Filoni on Ahsoka's Fate, Maul's Return and Much More|author=Goldman, Eric|date=2016-03-31|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20160401045238}} was a [[TIE/ad v1]] initially owned by the [[Eighth Brother]], a [[Terrelian Jango Jumper]] that was an [[Inquisitor]] of the [[Inquisitorius]]—an organization of the [[Galactic Empire]] responsible for hunting [[Jedi]] and other [[Force-sensitive]]s.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' However, after the Eighth [[Brother (Inquisitorius)|Brother's]] [[death]] on the [[planet]] [[Malachor]], the former [[Sith]] [[Maul]] took the [[TIE series|TIE]] [[Starfighter|fighter]] and left the planet. [[File:CockpitMaul-TwilightOfTheApprenticePart2.png|thumb|left|300px|Maul in the cockpit of the TIE/ad v1]] The starfighter measured 3.6 [[meter]]s long,[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] — Based on corresponding data for [[TIE/ad v1]] 6.6 meters wide, and 5.7 meters tall, or 11 [[Foot|feet]] and 7 inches long, 21 feet and 9 inches wide, and 18 feet and 8 inches tall. Equipped with a [[P-s5.2 twin ion engine]], the [[starship]] was able to achieve a maximum acceleration of 4,150 G, 105 [[megalight per hour]], and a maximum speed in [[atmosphere]] of 1,600 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] or 994 [[Mile per hour|miles per hour]]. The ship was outfitted with a Class 4.5 [[hyperdrive]] and an [[N-s6.a Navcon]] navigation system. With a [[T-s8.a targeting computer]], the TIE/ad v1 was armed with two [[L-s9.1 laser cannon]]s and a [[projectile launcher]]. For defensive measures, the TIE had [[Deflector shield generator|shielding]] implemented in its wings and an ejector seat for emergencies. With [[life support]] and room for one [[pilot]], the starship could carry two [[Standard day|days]] of rations. The starfighter cost 150,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. ==History== ===Now arriving at Malachor=== {{Quote|I don't see any ship.''"
"''It's gotta be around here somewhere. Chopper, try to get a fix on its location.|Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus|}} [[File:EighthBrother-StarWarsForceArena.jpg|thumb|right|160px|The Eighth Brother piloted the TIE/ad v1.]] The TIE/ad v1 was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] sometime between [[4 BBY]] and [[3 BBY]]. In 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Twilight of the Apprentice]]" to [[3 BBY]]. the Eighth Brother traveled to Malachor after tracking Maul to the planet's [[Malachor Sith Temple|Sith temple]], a task assigned to him by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], leader of the Inquisitorius. After the Eighth Brother's arrival on Malachor, [[Ezra Bridger]], [[C1-10P]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], and [[Ahsoka Tano]], members of the rebel cell [[Phoenix Cell]], [[Mission to Malachor|journeyed]] to the planet to investigate a way to defeat the Inquisitors. As they piloted their [[shuttle]], the ''[[Phantom]]'', through the planet's atmosphere, the [[Astromech droid|astromech]] C1-10P picked up the signal of the Eighth Brother's TIE/ad v1, but was unable to determine the type of ship. Under Jarrus's command, the [[droid]] began tracking the starship. With the ship tracked, Jarrus maneuvered the ''Phantom'' to land on the planet's surface, where they had tracked the Eighth Brother's starfighter, which was actually beneath the surface. As they disembarked their shuttle, Bridger commented on the TIE's absence. Jarrus affirmed that it had to be somewhere and instructed C1-10P, who remained on the shuttle, to try to locate the ship. As Bridger, Jarrus, and Tano investigated a nearby pillar, the group ended up falling through the planet's surface, discovering the [[Sith temple]] beneath. As the group moved toward the temple, Jarrus inquired with C1-10P if he had found the ship's trail, which the droid had. As they ventured further, Jarrus warned Bridger that the starship indicated another being's presence. [[File:ChopperFindsTheShip-TwilightOfTheApprenticePart1.png|thumb|300px|left|C1-10P found the Eighth Brother's TIE/ad v1 on Malachor.]] After the Eighth Brother ambushed the three rebels and subsequently realized he was outnumbered in [[lightsaber combat]], he fled, though he separated Bridger from the other two. As Jarrus and Tano gave chase, C1-10P contacted Jarrus to inform him that he had found the location of the Eighth Brother's TIE fighter. Jarrus inquired where and instructed the astromech to go to the ship and stop the Inquisitor from leaving while Jarrus and Tano followed his signal. C1-10P left the shuttle and traveled to the ship's location. The [[C1-series astromech droid|C1-series droid]] landed atop the TIE and raised his [[grasper arm]]s in victory shortly before dodging the [[Eighth Brother's lightsaber]] as the Inquisitor threw it, damaging the top of the TIE. As the Inquisitor caught his [[lightsaber]] and pressed forward, C1-10P commandeered the TIE, much to the Eighth Brother's frustration. ===Now departing Malachor=== {{Quote|Filthy droid.|The Eighth Brother|}} [[File:ChopperVsEighthBrother-TwilightOfTheApprenticePart1.png|thumb|right|300px|C1-10P fired laser cannons at the Eighth Brother from the TIE/ad v1.]] Before the Inquisitor could act against the droid, Jarrus and Tano arrived, catching his attention. The Eighth Brother prepared to [[Lightsaber duel|duel]] the two, but C1-10P activated the TIE fighter's controls and used the [[laser cannon]]s against the Inquisitor. While the Eighth Brother deflected the barrage of lasers, he was eventually hit in the side, knocking him to the ground and separating him from his [[weapon]]. Jarrus and Tano prevented the Terrelian Jango Jumper from reuniting with his lightsaber and bound his [[Limb|hands]]. They then interrogated the Inquisitor for information on his peers and the reason for his presence on Malachor in front of his TIE/ad v1. When the Sith temple activated, Jarrus and Tano abandoned the TIE fighter as they brought the Eighth Brother along to find Bridger. The Eighth Brother eventually escaped the rebels' captivity with the help of fellow Inquisitors, the [[Fifth Brother]] and [[Seventh Sister]]. He dueled Jarrus, Maul, and Tano alongside the Fifth Brother atop the temple but fell to his [[death]] when trying to flee the battle after Maul eliminated his companion. Maul, who survived a duel against Jarrus following the Inquisitors' deaths, located the TIE/ad v1 and piloted it off the planet. ==Behind the scenes== The Eighth Brother's TIE Fighter first appeared in part one of the two-part episode "[[Twilight of the Apprentice]]," the finale of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The episode aired on [[March 30]], [[2016]].{{InsiderCite|169|Star Wars Rebels: Season Two Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'': Season Two Episode Guide}} In an interview with [[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']] a [[March 31|day]] after the airing of "Twilight of the Apprentice," [[Dave Filoni]], co-creator of ''Rebels'', identified the starfighter as "Eighth Brother's TIE fighter." Filoni also revealed that, in a different version of the episode's script, the Eighth Brother would have survived his fall from the Sith temple, only to perish from the activation of the ancient weapon while retreating to his TIE. Additionally, the co-creator confirmed that Maul escaped in the Eighth Brother's TIE Advanced v1. [[File:MaulDatabank-Facebook.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Star Wars Rebel''{{'s}} Facebook account incorrectly claimed that Maul took Darth Vader's TIE advanced x1.]] The episode's accompanying guide's gallery erroneously states that after the Phoenix Cell members fell beneath the planet's surface, C1-10P tracked the Eighth Brother's ship as en route,{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/twilight-of-the-apprentice-episode-gallery-2|text=Twilight of the Apprentice Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} which conflicts with the episode's establishment of the Eighth Brother arriving on the planet before the rebels. On [[April 8]], 2016, the official ''Star Wars Rebels'' [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]] account erroneously stated that Maul had escaped in [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced]],{{Facebook|username=starwarsrebels|url=photo/?fbid=573352619488032|name=[[Star Wars Rebels]]|date=2016-04-08|archivedate=20251114201625}} contradicting Filoni's comment and the depiction of Maul in a TIE/ad v1 in the episode. In the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'', an image caption incorrectly stated that C1-1OP used the TIE to attack Maul,''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' when it was actually the Eighth Brother as depicted in "Twilight of the Apprentice" and in the image the caption accompanies. In [[2025]], a [[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|second edition]] of the book was released, repeating the error.[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Eighth Brother's TIE fighter|soundcat=Audio files of the Eighth Brother's TIE fighter}} *{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=Twilight of the Apprentice (comic story)|book=Maul: A Star Wars Rebels Cinestory Comic}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/twilight-of-the-apprentice-episode-guide|text="Twilight of the Apprentice" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{RebelsRecon|UiXf--t6oZE|Inside "The Holocrons of Fate"|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-the-holocrons-of-fate}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side Pocket Expert]]'' {{Po}} *{{DarthVaderCite|24|The Dark Side}} {{Po}} *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] *{{Databank|darth-maul|Maul}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2016/03/31/star-wars-rebels-dave-filoni-on-ahsokas-fate-mauls-return-and-much-more|text=Star Wars Rebels: Dave Filoni on Ahsoka's Fate, Maul's Return and Much More|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20160401045238}} {{1stID|Eighth Brother's TIE fighter}} [[Category:Captured starships]] [[Category:Starships of the Inquisitorius]] [[Category:TIE/ad v1s]]
